deed: חיילי צהל חילצו 19 ניצולים מהריסות טורקיה — ילד בן עשר בין הניצולים
title: IDF 'Olive Branches' delegation rescued 19 survivors alive from the rubble of the earthquake in Turkey

trailer.text: The IDF Home Front Command is regularly dispatched around the world to assist in natural disasters.
A 7.8-magnitude earthquake struck Turkey and Syria early on Monday and toppled buildings.
An Israeli delegation of some 150 search and rescue experts from the Home Front Command landed in Turkey early on Tuesday.
According to the delegation's interim summary, the team rescued 19 people alive from the rubble and began providing medical treatment at the field hospital in Kahramanmaras.
At the return ceremony at Ben Gurion Airport, Prime Minister Netanyahu told the delegation: "All of Israel is proud of you".

paragraphs.text: A 7.8-magnitude earthquake struck Turkey and Syria early on Monday and toppled buildings.
The Turkish authorities report that some 6,500 structures collapsed, and countless other buildings were damaged.
The death toll rose from day to day, and the sources give different figures.
According to experts, most earthquake survivors are extracted within 72 hours of the disaster.
The Turkish authorities arrested at least 12 suspects for involvement in the construction of buildings that collapsed.
Before the delegation set out, Defense Minister Yoav Gallant said he had spoken with the Turkish defense minister and offered the assistance of the defense establishment.
According to Jewish News, Israel dispatched emergency teams to Turkey on Monday night, following a request from President Erdogan.
According to Mako, the delegation set out in order to help the Turks cope with the disaster.
The delegation flew on a Boeing 707, and the equipment was transported on Hercules planes.
The medical delegation brought 7 tons of medical equipment for operating rooms, emergency reception and intensive care.
Some 150 search and rescue experts from the Home Front Command landed in Turkey early on Tuesday.
Alongside the Home Front Command, Magen David Adom, United Hatzalah and IsraAID also operated in southern Turkey.
The IDF delegation was also supported by medical specialists from the defense and health ministries, fire and rescue services, and Zaka.
United Hatzalah sent 25 first responders, and a team of six medical personnel was sent from Shaare Zedek Medical Center in Jerusalem.
Felix Lotan of Magen David Adom said it was difficult to get into the city, because the roads were destroyed and people were leaving while the rescue teams were entering.
On the first day of the rescue mission, 8.2.23, 8 people were rescued.
On the second day, 9.2.23, 9 were rescued.
On the third day, 10.2.23, another 2 were rescued.
The rescue teams worked at night and pulled at least four Turkish civilians from the rubble.
Lotan said the teams were working around the clock.
Col. (Res.) Golan Vach said the forces crawled under the floor and reached the basement, and there they heard something like a bird chirping.
It turned out that it was a child who had heard them and shouted.
According to Lotan, they drilled a hole through the basement and dragged out a 12-year-old boy, who received medical treatment and was taken to a hospital.
Vach said that four of the boy's family members had died in the same room.
Maj. (Res.) Matan Schneider, commander of one of the teams, said they rescued a 23-year-old woman in good condition, with only a fractured pelvis.
Lotan said the boy and the woman were rescued alive after almost 48 hours.
Schneider described the rescue as a complex four-and-a-half-hour mission that included a great deal of engineering work and the work of a doctor and paramedics.
Vach told Maariv that they dug and found a two-year-old child, and brought him out alive.
According to the IDF, the teams also retrieved from the rubble the bodies of Saul and Fortuna Cenudioglu, the heads of the Jewish community in Antakya.
On Friday evening, Israeli rescue teams pulled a 9-year-old boy from under a collapsed building, after he had been trapped for more than 120 hours.
The IDF identified him as Ridvan.
According to Mako, the rescue was complex and lasted more than 24 hours, and during it he was treated by an expert pediatrician from the delegation.
His sister Romisa, 14, and his father Mohammed had been rescued by the Israeli team earlier that week.
According to Mako, Ridvan was the delegation's 19th rescued person and the third from his family found alive.
According to Mako, his mother's body was found lifeless.
According to JNS, the IDF sent 230 medical and emergency response experts to set up a field hospital in Kahramanmaras.
The medical delegation is commanded by the deputy chief medical officer, Col. Dr. Tomer Kolar.
The hospital was fully operational from Friday morning.
It has intensive care, pediatrics, general surgery and orthopedics.
According to JNS, Syrian refugees were also treated there.

Lt. Col. Aziz Ibrahim treated a 4-year-old Syrian boy from the city of Homs. According to JNS he is a Medical Corps commander, and according to an IDF tweet he is an intensive care nurse and paramedic with the medical delegation.
Ibrahim said the boy had been rescued three or four days earlier, that his whole family had been killed, and that his uncle had brought him.
On Sunday the IDF said the search and rescue delegation was concluding its operations, and the medical delegation was continuing.
According to Israeli officials, the hospital will operate at least until the end of the week.
According to the delegation's interim summary, the rescue team rescued 19 people alive from the rubble.
According to the Times of Israel, the 19 were Turkish civilians.
Vach said that the speed with which they reached the scene is what brought the results.
According to him, the Israeli delegation was the largest, with the exception of Azerbaijan, which sent 400 people.
Vach said that in the city where they operated alone there were 10 delegations from around the world.
According to Vach, IDF aid delegations usually last between nine and 14 days, and the delegation was ready to stay that long.
Over the past forty years, the IDF has led 31 search and rescue delegations abroad.
In recent years, the Home Front Command has developed a system that generates a situational picture of very large areas.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu commended the work of the delegation on Wednesday.
He told Vach that the delegation was carrying out a humanitarian mission of the highest order and bringing great honor to the State of Israel.
According to the President's Office, Erdogan thanked President Herzog for his good wishes and for the rescue mission.
At the return ceremony at Ben Gurion Airport, Netanyahu told the delegation: "All of Israel is proud of you".
Defense Minister Yoav Gallant and Chief of Staff Herzi Halevi took part in the ceremony.
The Israeli rescue organization United Hatzalah announced that it would cease its operations in Turkey because of a significant security threat.
After Prime Minister Netanyahu said that Israel was planning to send aid to Syria as well, Syrian sources vigorously denied requesting aid from Israel.

claims.text: ואך אמר שכל מדינות העולם שולחות משלחות ושרק בעיר שבה פעלו יש 10 משלחות מהעולם.
claims.quote: כל מדינות העולם שולחות משלחות ורק בעיר שלנו יש 10 משלחות מהעולם

claims.text: לפי ואך, משלחות סיוע של צה"ל נמשכות בדרך כלל בין תשעה ל-14 ימים, והמשלחת הייתה מוכנה להישאר כל כך הרבה זמן.
claims.quote: Vach said such IDF aid delegations usually last between nine and 14 days, and in this case, were ready to stay that long.

claims.text: בארבעים השנים האחרונות הובילו צה"ל 31 משלחות חיפוש והצלה בחו"ל.
claims.quote: The IDF has led 31 search and rescue delegations abroad over the past 40 years.

claims.text: בשנים האחרונות פיתח פיקוד העורף מערכת היוצרת תמונת מצב של שטחים גדולים מאוד.
claims.quote: the IDF Home Front Command has developed a system that can generate a situational picture of very large areas

claims.text: ראש הממשלה הישראלי בנימין נתניהו שיבח ביום רביעי את עבודת משלחת החיפוש וההצלה של צה"ל.
claims.quote: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday commended the work of the IDF search and rescue delegation

claims.text: ראש הממשלה נתניהו אמר לוואך שהמשלחת עושה משימה הומניטרית מהמעלה הראשונה ומביאה כבוד רב למדינת ישראל.
claims.quote: You are carrying out a humanitarian mission of the highest order and are bringing much honor to us and the State of Israel

claims.text: לפי לשכת הנשיא, ארדואן הודה לנשיא הרצוג על איחולי הטוב ועל משימת החילוץ.
claims.quote: Erdoğan thanked Herzog for his good wishes and for the rescue mission

claims.text: ארגון הצלה הישראלי איחוד הצלה הודיע שיפסיק את פעילותו בטורקיה בגלל איום ביטחוני משמעותי.
claims.quote: an aid delegation from the Israeli charity United Hatzalah announced that it would cease operations in Turkey and return home

claims.text: מקורות סוריים הכחישו בתוקף שביקשו סיוע מישראל.
claims.quote: But Syrian sources vigorously denied requesting aid from Israel

claims.text: לפי Jewish News, ילד בן 10 שארבעה מבני משפחתו נהרגו ברעידה חולץ גם הוא ביום רביעי.
claims.quote: A 10-year-old boy, whose four family members were killed in the earthquake, was also rescued earlier on Wednesday.

claims.text: לפי JNS, עד יום שבת חילצה משלחת "ענפי זית" של צה"ל בטורקיה 19 בני אדם מההריסות, ברעידות האדמה שהרגו יותר מ-28,000 בני אדם בטורקיה ובסוריה.
claims.quote: had as of Saturday rescued 19 people from the rubble caused by the massive earthquakes that killed more than 28,000 people

claims.text: לפי Jewish News, צוותי חירום ישראליים הצילו 10 אנשים ברעידה שהרגה יותר מ-16,000.
claims.quote: Israeli emergency teams in Turkey have saved 10 people caught in a deadly earthquake that left over 16,000 people killed.

claims.text: לפי Algemeiner/JNS, בתוך יום מתחילת הפעילות הצילה המשלחת 10 אנשים ממבנים שקרסו.
claims.quote: has saved 10 people from collapsed buildings since starting its work the previous day

claims.text: לפי סגן ראש נציגות ישראל בטורקיה, יותר מ-300 איש טופלו בבית החולים השדה שהקימה ישראל.
claims.quote: More than 300 people have been treated in a field hospital set up by Israel in Turkey

claims.text: לפי סיכום הביניים, צוות החילוץ מונה כ-150 איש והצוות הרפואי 250 איש.
claims.quote: The rescue team includes about 150 people and the medical team includes 250 people.

claims.text: אל"ם (מיל') גולן ואך הוא ראש משלחת הסיוע הישראלית.
claims.quote: the head of the aid delegation, Col. (Res.) Golan Vach, said the Israeli teams had been the most successful so far

claims.text: לפי JNS, אל"ם אלעד אדרי, ראש חטיבת החילוץ של פיקוד העורף, הוביל את המשלחת.
claims.quote: The delegation is being led by Col. Elad Edri, head of the Home Front Command Search and Rescue Brigade.

claims.text: לפי Jewish News, צוות אחר הציל אישה בת 21 בלילה הקודם.
claims.quote: Israeli rescue teams operating in the Turkish city of Kahramanmaras managed to save a 12-year-old boy, while another team saved a 21-year-old woman last night.

quote_translations.c49: The Turkish authorities report that some 6,500 structures collapsed across the country and countless other buildings were damaged
quote_translations.c51: The death toll rose today (Saturday) to more than 25 thousand people
quote_translations.c50: The Turkish authorities arrested at least 12 suspects for involvement in the construction of some of the buildings that collapsed
quote_translations.c48: Before the delegation set out, Defense Minister Gallant said that he had spoken with the Turkish defense minister about the grave event and offered the assistance of the defense establishment
quote_translations.c7: The Israeli delegation set out for Turkey on Monday, in order to help the Turks cope with the disaster that struck the country
quote_translations.c23: We dig and find a two-year-old child, we bring him out of the belly of the earth alive
quote_translations.c6: During the complex rescue, which lasted more than 24 hours, Ridvan received medical treatment from an expert pediatrician from the delegation.
quote_translations.c4: Ridvan is the 19th person rescued by the Israeli delegation, and the third found alive from the same family; his father and his 14-year-old sister were also rescued by the delegation while still alive
quote_translations.c5: However, his mother's body was found lifeless.
quote_translations.c68: All the countries of the world are sending delegations, and in our city alone there are 10 delegations from around the world
